notes:
Statistics retained as printed. Original and replication tests extracted independently. No metric conversion. Original p verified visually on publisher PDF p. 14 because cache OCR garbles the similarity p value. Replication reports an additional interaction inconsistent with original independence; no explicit effect-specific replication verdict for this main effect, so reported_success is null.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Experiment and named main effect identify the target; retain printed partial eta-squared without converting to eta-squared.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly report the phonological-similarity main effect as present. Their failure to replicate independence concerns the interaction, not this assigned main effect.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Named main effect and experiment/outcome match the supplied locator; requested test statistic is printed as F. No conversion.
